majority_note: Opening day 50 D, 50 R: Democratic from 3 to 20 January 2001 through outgoing Vice President Gore's tie-breaking vote; Republican from 20 January 2001 through Vice President Cheney's; Democratic from 6 June 2001, after Jim Jeffords left the Republicans to sit as an independent caucusing with the Democrats.

Opening day 51 R, 46 D, 2 independents, 1 vacant: Republican until the Georgia runoff winners were seated. Democratic from 20 January 2021, with both independents caucusing with the Democrats and Vice President Harris's tie-breaking vote.
